name: cross-chain-dca-extend-yarn
description: Yarn-only Hardhat-aware target validation after the Cross-Chain Flow extension. Named install allows fingerprint skip across attempts. Root yarn lint covers nextjs + hardhat. Does not require Sepolia RPC or live Axelar for this gate.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install Next.js and Hardhat workspaces with Yarn (pilot is yarn-only).

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: Lint the extended frontend and Hardhat workspace.
